steps.en: Reduction was applied successfully in OCMS or via PLUS
steps.id: Reduction berhasil diterapkan di OCMS atau lewat PLUS
steps.why_en: Only the PLUS route exists; no reduction screen for staff in OCMS was found.
steps.why_id: Hanya jalur PLUS yang ada; layar reduction untuk staff di OCMS tidak ditemukan.

steps.en: Reduced notice is marked as temporarily suspended (TS-RED)
steps.id: Notice yang di-reduce ditandai suspended sementara (TS-RED)

steps.en: Reduction period is set by its expiry date
steps.id: Masa reduction ditentukan oleh tanggal kedaluwarsanya

steps.en: Reminder letter run skips suspended notices, so none escalate
steps.id: Proses surat reminder melewati notice yang suspended, jadi tidak naik tahap

steps.en: Preparation for the next stage also skips suspended notices
steps.id: Persiapan data tahap berikutnya juga melewati notice yang suspended

steps.en: SMS and email reminders are not sent during the reduction
steps.id: Reminder SMS dan email tidak dikirim selama masa reduction
steps.why_en: The check exists but the SMS and email job is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ada, tetapi job SMS dan email dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: After the reduction ends, the notice revives and reminders can resume
steps.id: Setelah reduction selesai, notice aktif lagi dan reminder bisa jalan
